items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Jafar, from his father: Imam (a.s) said: “That Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to like breaking the fast upon milk.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ:» أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :كَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ عَلَى اَللَّبَنِ«.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “It is recommended for the fasting person, if he is able to do that, to pray (salah) before he breaks the fast.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلصَّائِمِ إِنْ قَوِيَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad (a.s), from his fathers (a.s), peace be upon them: Imam (a.s) said: “When the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, broke the fast, He (saws) would say: ‘O Allah (swt), for You (swt) we fasted, and upon Your (swt) provision we broke the fast, so accept it from us. The thirst has gone, the veins have become moist, and the reward remains.’” (Allahumma laka sumna, wa ‘ala rizqika aftarna, fa-taqabbalhu minna. Dhahaba al-zama’u, wa ibtallati al-‘uruqu, wa baqiya al-ajru)
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ كَانَ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ قَالَ» اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْنَا وَ عَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْنَا فَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنَّا ذَهَبَ اَلظَّمَأُ وَاِبْتَلَّتِ اَلْعُرُوقُ وَ بَقِيَ اَلْأَجْرُ««.
items.h: Chapter on the Words and Supplication at the Time of Breaking the Fast (Iftar)

items.e: And from him, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa’adan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “You say on every night of the month of Ramadan at the time of breaking the fast, until its end: ‘Praise belongs to Allah (swt), who helped us, so we fasted, and provided for us, so we broke our fast. O Allah (swt), accept from us, help us in it, keep us safe in it, and receive it from us with ease from You (swt) and well-being. And praise belongs to Allah (swt), who has completed for us a day from the month of Ramadan.” (Alhamdu lillahi alladhi a‘anana fa-sumna, wa razaqana fa-aftarna. Allahumma taqabbal minna, wa a‘inna ‘alayhi, wa sallimna fihi, wa tasallamhu minna fi yusrin minka wa ‘afiyah. Walhamdu lillahi alladhi qada ‘anna yawman min shahri Ramadan)
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »تَقُولُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ عِنْدَ اَلْإِفْطَارِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي أَعَانَنَا فَصُمْنَا وَرَزَقَنَا فَأَفْطَرْنَا اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا وَ أَعِنَّا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْنَا فِيهِ وَتَسَلَّمْهُ مِنَّا فِي يُسْرٍ مِنْكَ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي قَضَى عَنَّا يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Abi al-Jahm, from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Qanbar, the freed slave of Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, came to Imam (a.s) with his food for breaking the fast.” Imam (a.s) said: “So he (Qanbar) came with a sack in which there was sawiq (porridge-like dish), upon which there was a seal. A man then said to Imam Ali (a.s): “O Commander of the Faithful (a.s), this is indeed miserliness, that you seal your food.’” Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, laughed. Then Imam Ali (a.s) said: “Is it other than that? I do not like anything to enter my stomach except something whose path I know.” Then Imam Ali (a.s) broke the seal, took out some sawiq from it, placed some of it in a cup, and gave it to him (the man). Imam Ali (a.s) took the cup, and when he wanted to drink, he said: ‘In the name of Allah (swt). O Allah (swt), for You (swt) we have fasted, and upon Your (swt) provision we have broken our fast, so accept from us. Indeed, You (swt) are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.’” (Bismillah. Allahumma laka sumna, wa ‘ala rizqika aftarna, fa-taqabbal minna. Innaka anta al-sami‘u al-‘alim)
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْجَهْمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ اَلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» جَاءَ قَنْبَرٌ مَوْلَى عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِفِطْرِهِ إِلَيْهِ« قَالَ» فَجَاءَ بِجِرَابٍ فِيهِ سَوِيقٌ عَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ« قَالَ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ اَلْبُخْلُ تَخْتِمُ عَلَى طَعَامِكَ« قَالَ» فَضَحِكَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« قَالَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ» أَوَ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ لاَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بَطْنِي شَيْءٌ إِلاَّ شَيْءٌ أَعْرِفُ سَبِيلَهُ«« قَالَ» ثُمَّ كَسَرَ اَلْخَاتَمَ فَأَخْرَجَ مِنْهُ سَوِيقاً فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ فِي قَدَحٍ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ فَأَخَذَ اَلْقَدَحَ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَشْرَبَ قَالَ» بِسْمِ اَللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْنَا وَ عَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْنَا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا» إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ اَلسَّمِيعُ اَلْعَلِيمُ«««.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Salamah, the companion of al-Sabiri, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever gives a fasting person food with which to break his fast, then he shall have the like of his reward.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ صَاحِبِ اَلسَّابِرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »مَنْ فَطَّرَ صَائِماً فَلَهُ مِ ثْ لُ أَ جْ رِ هِ«.
items.h: Chapter on Merit of Volunteering in Good Deeds

items.e: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa’adan ibn Muslim, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam (a.s) said: “You giving your fasting brother food, with which to break his fast, is better than your fasting.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِطْرُكَ أَخَاكَ اَلصَّائِمَ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صِيَامِكَ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “Sadir entered upon my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) in the month of Ramadan. And Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “O Sadir, do you know which nights these are?” So he (Sadir) said: “Yes, may my father be your ransom, these are the nights of the month of Ramadan. So what about it?” Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said to him: “Are you able to free, on every night of these nights, ten slaves from the children of Ismail?” So Sadir said to him: “May my father and my mother be your ransom, my wealth does not reach that.” Imam al-Baqir (a.s) continued reducing it until he brought it down to one slave, and in all of that he (Sadir) would say, ‘I am not able to do it.’ Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said to him: “Then are you not able to give, on every night, a Muslim man food with which to break his fast?” Sadir said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Yes, and ten.” So my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) said to Sadir: “That is what I intended, O Sadir. Your giving your Muslim brother food, with which to break his fast, is equal to freeing a slave from the children of Ismail.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» دَخَلَ سَدِيرٌ عَلَى أَبِي فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» يَا سَدِيرُ هَلْ تَدْرِي أَيُّ لَيَالٍ هَذِهِ« فَقَالَ نَعَمْ فِدَاكَ أَبِي هَذِهِ لَيَالِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَمَاذَا فَقَالَ لَهُ» أَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ تُعْتِقَ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنَ اَللَّيَالِي عَشْرَ رِقَابٍ مِنْ وُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ« فَقَالَ لَهُ سَدِيرٌ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي لاَ يَبْلُغُ مَالِي ذَلِكَ فَمَا زَالَ يُنْقِصُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ بِهِ رَقَبَةً وَاحِدَةً فِي كُلِّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ لاَ أَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ» فَمَا تَقْدِرُ أَنْ تُفَطِّرَ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ رَجُلاً مُسْلِماً« فَقَالَ لَهُ بَلَى وَ عَشَرَةً فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي» فَذَاكَ اَلَّذِي أَرَدْتُ يَا سَدِيرُ إِفْطَارُكَ أَخَاكَ اَلْمُسْلِمَ يَعْدِلُ رَقَبَةً مِنْ وُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ««.

items.e: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Hammad ibn Zayd, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘Whoever gives a fasting person food with which to break his fast, he shall have the like of his reward, without anything being diminished from it, and whatever righteousness he does through the strength of that food.’”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» مَنْ فَطَّرَ صَائِماً كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَنْقُصَ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَ مَا عَمِلَ بِقُوَّةِ ذَلِكَ اَلطَّعَامِ مِنْ بِرٍّ«.

items.e: And from him, from Jafar ibn Uthman, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu al-Ward, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, delivered a sermon on the last Friday of Shaban. The Prophet (saws) praised Allah (swt) and extolled Him (swt), and spoke some words, then said: ‘The month of Ramadan has come upon you. Whoever gives a fasting person food with which to break his fast in it, by that he shall have with Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, the freeing of a slave and forgiveness of his past sins.’ It was said to the Prophet (saws): “O Messenger of Allah (swt), not all of us are able to give a fasting person food with which to break his fast.” Prophet (saws) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) is generous. He (swt) gives this reward to one who is not able except to provide a mixture of milk (madhqah) with which he gives a fasting person to break his fast, or a drink of fresh water, or some dates, and he is not able to provide more than that.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْوَرْدِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي آخِرِ جُمُعَةٍ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَتَكَلَّمَ بِكَلاَمٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ »قَدْ أَظَلَّكُمْ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ مَنْ فَطَّرَ فِيهِ صَائِماً كَانَ لَهُ بِذَلِكَ عِنْدَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ وَ مَغْفِرَةُ ذُنُوبِهِ فِيمَا مَضَى« قِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ لَيْسَ كُلُّنَا نَقْدِرُ أَنْ نُفَطِّرَ صَائِماً قَالَ» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ كَرِيمٌ يُعْطِي هَذَا اَلثَّوَابَ لِمَنْ لاَ يَقْدِرُ إِلاَّ عَلَى مَذْقَةٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ يُفَطِّرُ بِهَا صَائِماً أَوْ شَرْبَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ عَذْبٍ أَوْ تَمَرَاتٍ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ««.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Nothing harms the fasting person in what he does if he avoids three qualities; food and drink, women, and immersion in water (al-irtimas fi al-ma).”
items.o: الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان عن محمد بن مسلم قال: سمعت ابا جعفر عليه السلام يقول: لا يضر الصائم ما صنع إذا اجتنب ثلاث خصال: الطعام والشراب، والنساء، والارتماس في الماء
items.h: Chapter on What Invalidates Fasting, What Impairs the Conditions of Its Obligation, and Nullifies Fasting

items.e: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Abu Basir, who said: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “A lie invalidates ablution and breaks the fast.” He (narrator) said: “I said, ‘We are ruined.’” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not as you think. That is only lying against Allah (swt), against His Messenger (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and against the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» اَلْكَذِبَةُ تَنْقُضُ اَلْوُضُوءَ وَ تُفَطِّرُ اَلصِّيَامَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ هَلَكْنَا قَالَ» لَيْسَ حَيْثُ تَذْهَبُ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ اَلْكَذِبُ عَلَى اَللَّهِ وَعَلَى رَسُولِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ عَلَى اَلْأَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ«.

items.e: And al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who lied in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He has broken his fast, and upon him is its making up, while he is fasting; he makes up his fast and his ablution if he did so deliberately.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَذَبَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ »قَدْ أَفْطَرَ وَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاؤُهُ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ يَقْضِي صَوْمَهُ وَ وُضُوءَهُ إِذَا تَعَمَّدَ«.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting person may immerse himself in water, but he must not submerge his head.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلصَّائِمُ يَسْتَنْقِعُ فِي اَلْمَاءِ وَ لاَ يَرْمُسُ رَأْسَهُ«.

items.e: And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting person and the person in the state of ihram must not submerge his head in water.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ يَرْمُسُ اَلصَّائِمُ وَ لاَ اَلْمُحْرِمُ رَأْسَهُ فِي اَلْمَاءِ«.

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: He (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who administers an enema (yahtaqin), while he has an illness in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting person is not permitted to administer an enema.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَحْتَقِنُ تَكُونُ بِهِ اَلْعِلَّةُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» اَلصَّائِمُ لاَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَحْتَقِنَ«.

items.e: And that which Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his father, who said: I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s): “What do you say regarding gentle treatment with suppositories (ashyaf), which a person inserts while he is fasting?” So the Imam (a.s), wrote: “There is no harm in the solid one.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي اَلتَّلَطُّفِ بِالْأَشْيَافِ يَسْتَدْخِلُهُ اَلْإِنْسَانُ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْجَامِدِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting person may soak himself in water, pour water over his head, cool himself with a garment, sprinkle (damp) the fan, and sprinkle (damp) the reed mat (al-buriya), but he must not immerse his head in water.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلصَّائِمُ يَسْتَنْقِعُ فِي اَلْمَاءِ وَيَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَيَتَبَرَّدُ بِالثَّوْبِ وَيَنْضِحُ اَلْمِرْوَحَةَ وَيَنْضِحُ اَلْبُورِيَاءَ وَ لاَ يَغْمِسُ رَأْسَهُ فِي اَلْمَاءِ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Ali ibn Ribat, from Ibn Muskan, from Layth al-Muradi, who said: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the fasting person undergoing cupping and pouring oil into his ear.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, except snuff (al-suoot), for it is disliked.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ اَلْمُرَادِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ يَحْتَجِمُ وَ يَصُبُّ فِي أُذُنِهِ اَلدُّهْنَ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ إِلاَّ اَلسُّعُوطُ فَإِنَّهُ يُكْرَهُ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, from Yunus, who said: He said: “The fasting person in the month of Ramadan may use the tooth-stick (siwak) whenever he wishes, and if he rinses his mouth at the time of an obligatory prayer and water enters his throat, then there is nothing upon him, and his fast is complete. But if he rinses his mouth at other than the time of an obligatory prayer and water enters his throat, then upon him is repetition. So it is better for the fasting person not to rinse his mouth.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلرَّيَّانِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ:» اَلصَّائِمُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ يَسْتَاكُ مَتَى شَاءَ وَإِنْ تَمَضْمَضَ فِي وَقْتِ فَرِيضَةٍ فَدَخَلَ اَلْمَاءُ حَلْقَهُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ تَمَّ صَوْمُهُ وَ إِنْ تَمَضْمَضَ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ فَرِيضَةٍ فَدَخَلَ اَلْمَاءُ حَلْقَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلْإِعَادَةُ فَالْأَفْضَلُ لِلصَّائِمِ أَنْ لاَ يَتَمَضْمَضَ«.

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who deliberately broke his fast in the month of Ramadan for one day without an excuse.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He frees a soul, or fasts two consecutive months, or feeds sixty needy persons. If he is not able, he gives charity with whatever he can bear.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً يَوْماً وَاحِداً مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ قَالَ »يُعْتِقُ نَسَمَةً أَوْ يَصُومُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ أَوْ يُطْعِمُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ تَصَدَّقَ بِمَا يُطِيقُ«.
items.h: Chapter on Expiation for Intentionally Breaking the Fast of a Day from the Month of Ramadan

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: That Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who deliberately broke his fast for a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “A man came to the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and said: ‘I am ruined, O Messenger of Allah (swt).’ The Prophet (saws) said: “What is the matter with you?” He replied: “The Fire, O Messenger of Allah (swt).” So the Prophet (saws) said: “And what is the matter with you?” He said: “I had intercourse with my wife (when fasting).” So the Prophet (saws) said: “Give charity and seek forgiveness from your Lord (azj).” The man replied: “By the One (swt) who has magnified your right, I have not left in the house anything, neither little nor much (to give as charity).” The Imam (a.s) continues that ‘then a man from among the people entered with a basket (miktal) of dates, in which there were twenty sa’, which would be ten sa’ according to our sa’.’ So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said to the man: “Take these dates and give them in charity.” He replied: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), to whom shall I give them in charity, when I have already informed you that there is nothing in my house, neither little nor much?” The Prophet (saws) said: “Then take it, feed it to your dependants, and seek forgiveness from Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic.” He (narrator) said: “When we returned, our companions said: ‘He began with freeing.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Free (slaves), or fast (consecutively), or give charity.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً فَقَالَ» إِنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَقَالَ هَلَكْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ فَقَالَ» مَا لَكَ« قَالَ اَلنَّارُ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ فَقَالَ» وَ مَا لَكَ« فَقَالَ وَقَعْتُ عَلَى أَهْلِي فَقَالَ» تَصَدَّقْ وَاِسْتَغْفِرْ رَبَّكَ« فَقَالَ اَلرَّجُلُ فَوَاَلَّذِي عَظَّمَ حَقَّكَ مَا تَرَكْتُ فِي اَلْبَيْتِ شَيْئاً قَلِيلاً وَ لاَ كَثِيراً قَالَ فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ بِمِكْتَلٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ فِيهِ عِشْرُونَ صَاعاً يَكُونُ عَشَرَةَ أَصْوُعٍ بِصَاعِنَا فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» خُذْ هَذَا اَلتَّمْرَ فَتَصَدَّقْ بِهِ« فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ وَ قَدْ أَخْبَرْتُكَ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي بَيْتِي قَلِيلٌ وَ لاَ كَثِيرٌ قَالَ» فَخُذْهُ فَأَطْعِمْهُ عِيَالَكَ وَاِسْتَغْفِرِ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ« قَالَ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا قَالَ أَصْحَابُنَا إِنَّهُ بَدَأَ بِالْعِتْقِ قَالَ» أَعْتِقْ أَوْ صُمْ أَوْ تَصَدَّقْ««.

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘a man who had intercourse with his wife in the month of Ramadan and did not find anything with which to give charity to sixty needy persons.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives charity with whatever he can bear.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ وَقَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يَتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ عَلَى سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً قَالَ» يَتَصَدَّقُ بِمَا يُطِيقُ«.
